## Description

Runs `PII_stata_scan.do` (top level of the repository) in Stata from inside the deposit directory, to flag variables that may contain personally identifiable information (PII). Needs Stata, so the pipeline runs it in the `larsvilhuber/bitbucket-stata` image. [24_amend_report.sh](#help-24_amend_report) turns the summary into a report paragraph.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/16_run_pii_scanner.sh <directory>
```

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `ProcessPii` - When `no`, the script exits immediately.

## Outputs

- `generated/PII_stata_scan.log` - Full Stata log
- `generated/PII_stata_scan_summary.txt` - Last 10 lines of the log
- `generated/pii_stata_output.csv` - Flagged variables
- `generated/pii_stata_output.md` - The first 20 rows of that file
